item.title: Agent Memory
item.description:
Motivation:

  • Context window is limited.
  • Automatically getting relevant info would also be pretty cool.

There is an external database that stores the relevant information. It must support querying, and curating.

Some must be never forgotten, some must be forgotten.

The important/interesting thing is how curation happens.

Quite interesting to realize that evals must take into account probably a dynamic memory.
